cvs: 'Red Robin' – much larger, to several metres · PINK MARBLE ('Cassini') – cream-and-pink variegated leaves · 'Louise' – variegated, red-tinged new growth
foliage: evergreen; glossy, leathery oval leaves, bright red when young
hardinessNote: Hardy through a cold UK winter, approximately -15 to -10°C.
pollination: not applicable; grown for foliage, flowers are rarely produced on this dwarf form
prune: Trim lightly after the spring flush and again in late summer to trigger fresh red growth; avoid cutting in frosty weather.
resilience: Tough, compact evergreen once established, good for low hedges and screening. Leaf spot can mar foliage in wet years. Pests: occasional aphids; prone to leaf spot and powdery mildew.
toxicity: Leaves and seeds are cyanogenic and should not be eaten; keep children and browsing pets or livestock away from the foliage.
uncertain: size: RHS 1–1.5 m over 10–20 years; nurseries quote about 1 m
uses: Low hedges · borders · patio containers · year-round structure
visual: Bright red new shoots fading to glossy green · compact Red Robin for small hedges and pots
water: Water regularly through the first year, then only in prolonged dry spells. Never let pots dry out.
